answer: Make identity expensive to fake with a cedar-like stake: each account posts a refundable bond, slashed when proven fake, and the bond grows with every sibling identity sharing a device or payment trail. Require attestations from established peers who stake their own standing on a newcomer, so a lagoon of sockpuppets needs real relationships, not just scripts. Cap new accounts' earnings behind a glacier-slow aging curve: fresh identities earn nothing for the first epochs, so a sybil flood pays nothing before it is detected.
